title: OnboardingManifestPayload
description: Payload schema for Manifest entries with kind='onboarding'. Declares the set of upgrade prompts the substrate may surface to anonymous/session humans, including trigger conditions and display content. Stored as payload_json in a Manifest DHT entry in the elohim DNA content_store zome.

prompts.description: Ordered list of upgrade prompt definitions. The substrate projects active prompts by matching each prompt's triggerCondition against the agent's SessionHumanView.

trigger.description: The lamadEventType or session condition that activates this prompt

triggerCondition.description: Condition evaluated against SessionHumanView to determine if this prompt is active

operator.description: Comparison operator: gte=>=, gt=>, eq===, always=unconditional

threshold.description: Threshold value for the comparison (ignored when operator='always')

title.description: Short display title for the prompt

message.description: Human-readable message explaining why the prompt appeared

benefits.description: Bullet-point benefits the agent gains by upgrading
